example.yar:
/*
   Regla de ejemplo para malpipe.
   Añade aquí tus propias reglas (.yar / .yara). Se compilan y aplican todas.
*/

rule Ejemplo_Persistencia_RunKey
{
    meta:
        author      = "Carlos Villalba Lagos"
        description = "Indicadores genéricos de persistencia por clave Run del registro"
        reference   = "MITRE ATT&CK T1547.001"
        severity    = "medium"

    strings:
        $run1 = "Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run" ascii wide nocase
        $run2 = "CurrentVersion\\RunOnce" ascii wide nocase
        $api1 = "RegSetValueEx" ascii
        $api2 = "RegCreateKeyEx" ascii

    condition:
        // un PE que referencia la clave Run y además importa APIs de escritura de registro
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and 1 of ($run*) and 1 of ($api*)
}
malware.yar:
/*
   Reglas YARA de arranque para malpipe.
   Amplíalas con reglas propias o de repositorios como YARA-Rules/rules.
   Uso exclusivamente defensivo.
*/

rule EICAR_Test_File
{
    meta:
        description = "Fichero de prueba antivirus EICAR (benigno, no es malware)"
        severity = "info"
    strings:
        $eicar = "X5O!P%@AP[4\\PZX54(P^)7CC)7}$EICAR-STANDARD-ANTIVIRUS-TEST-FILE!$H+H*"
    condition:
        $eicar
}

rule Embedded_PE
{
    meta:
        description = "Segundo ejecutable PE embebido (dropper / payload)"
        severity = "medium"
    strings:
        $mz = "This program cannot be run in DOS mode"
    condition:
        #mz > 1
}

rule Packer_UPX
{
    meta:
        description = "Indicadores del empaquetador UPX"
        severity = "low"
    strings:
        $u1 = "UPX0"
        $u2 = "UPX1"
        $u3 = "UPX!"
    condition:
        2 of them
}

rule Obfuscated_PowerShell
{
    meta:
        description = "PowerShell ofuscado / codificado"
        severity = "medium"
    strings:
        $a = "-EncodedCommand" nocase
        $b = "FromBase64String" nocase
        $c = "IEX" nocase
        $d = "Invoke-Expression" nocase
        $e = "DownloadString" nocase
    condition:
        2 of them
}

rule Ransomware_Note_Indicators
{
    meta:
        description = "Cadenas típicas de nota de rescate"
        severity = "high"
    strings:
        $a = "your files have been encrypted" nocase
        $b = "how to decrypt" nocase
        $c = ".onion" nocase
        $d = "bitcoin" nocase
        $e = "decryptor" nocase
    condition:
        2 of them
}

rule Injection_APIs
{
    meta:
        description = "Combinación de APIs de inyección de código en proceso remoto"
        severity = "high"
    strings:
        $a = "VirtualAllocEx"
        $b = "WriteProcessMemory"
        $c = "CreateRemoteThread"
        $d = "NtUnmapViewOfSection"
        $e = "QueueUserAPC"
    condition:
        3 of them
}
